ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: System-A has successfully validated a settlement request
ambiguity_resolubility.supported_interpretation: The settlement request itself is valid and meets all necessary criteria for processing, as determined by System-A's validation checks.
evidence_from_requirement: Business rule BR-01 states that an acknowledge message is sent to System-B only after the settlement request has passed validation. This implies that the validation process is not just error-free but also successful in determining the validity of the settlement request.
evidence_from_context: Glossary: 'settlement request' definition — Message requesting settlement of a financial instrument. This suggests that the validation checks are focused on ensuring the settlement request meets necessary criteria for processing, rather than simply completing without errors.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text and controlled context provide sufficient evidence to select one interpretation over the other. The business rule BR-01 and glossary definition of 'settlement request' support the reading that the validation process is successful in determining the validity of the settlement request.
